t: Local Subscription Studio | Design plans and simulate billing without a server
Design a demo subscription product in the browser without a server: create plans and pricing, simulate billing, manage roles, blog, pages, and themes, save everything locally, and export it easily.
Local Subscription Studio for designing and launching a demo product

Yes, you can design and launch a complete demo subscription product entirely in the browser with no server or database, using this local studio that brings together plan creation, monthly and annual pricing, and trial activation, then tests the billing flow step by step from selecting a plan and entering a discount to approving a demo payment or simulating its failure. It also helps you manage roles, permissions, profiles, and notifications; edit blog posts, pages, and the change log; and try different themes and add-ons before approving them, while automatically saving all changes to browser local storage and exporting and importing them at any time so you can continue working easily and securely.

Does this studio work without a server or databases?
Yes, it runs entirely in the browser and saves all data in local storage. You can export and import it as text.
How do I test the billing flow before launch?
Select a plan and billing cycle, then run the simulation. Try a discount code and trial period, then confirm a successful payment or simulate a failure.
Do permissions change based on the current role?
Yes, edit each role's permissions from the dashboard. The current role determines whether you can manage plans, content, and export.
Can I safely try themes and add-ons?
Yes, apply a theme to the studio locally and enable add-ons such as discounts, analytics, and currency conversion, then save or revert them.
What happens when all data is deleted?
The reset button clears local storage and restores default values, so export your settings first if you want to keep them.
